passages.text: Our class prepares materials for a small model of the neighbourhood. Cutting large sheets before planning the shapes could be a waste of paper. Each item on our supply list is checked against the materials already in the cupboard. A pupil finds several useful pieces left from an earlier project. We draw the shapes on these pieces first and only take new sheets when necessary. At the end, we save the unused pieces in a labelled box so the next group can find them easily.

parallelText.en: Our class prepares materials for a small model of the neighbourhood.
parallelText.zh: 我们班为一个社区小模型准备材料。

parallelText.en: Cutting large sheets before planning the shapes could be a waste of paper.
parallelText.zh: 还没规划形状就裁大纸，可能会造成纸张浪费。

parallelText.en: Each item on our supply list is checked against the materials already in the cupboard.
parallelText.zh: 我们把材料单上的每件物品都和柜子里已有材料核对。

parallelText.en: A pupil finds several useful pieces left from an earlier project.
parallelText.zh: 一位学生找到了先前项目剩下的几块可用材料。

parallelText.en: We draw the shapes on these pieces first and only take new sheets when necessary.
parallelText.zh: 我们先在这些材料上画形状，只有需要时才拿新纸。

parallelText.en: At the end, we save the unused pieces in a labelled box so the next group can find them easily.
parallelText.zh: 最后，我们把未用的材料存进贴有标签的盒子，让下一个小组容易找到。

passages.text: The drama group borrows several animal toys for a classroom performance. One toy rabbit has soft fabric, and its owner asks the group to keep it away from wet paint. A helper puts a sticker with the owner’s name on the rabbit’s storage box. The pupils make a separate clean corner for all the borrowed toys. After the performance, they use the names on the boxes to return each toy to the right person. The rabbit goes home clean and dry, and the owner thanks them for taking care of it.

parallelText.en: The drama group borrows several animal toys for a classroom performance.
parallelText.zh: 戏剧小组为课堂演出借了几只动物玩具。

parallelText.en: One toy rabbit has soft fabric, and its owner asks the group to keep it away from wet paint.
parallelText.zh: 一只玩具兔的面料很软，主人请小组让它远离未干的颜料。

parallelText.en: A helper puts a sticker with the owner’s name on the rabbit’s storage box.
parallelText.zh: 一位帮忙者把写有主人姓名的贴纸贴在兔子的收纳盒上。

parallelText.en: The pupils make a separate clean corner for all the borrowed toys.
parallelText.zh: 学生们为借来的玩具准备了一个独立、干净的角落。

parallelText.en: After the performance, they use the names on the boxes to return each toy to the right person.
parallelText.zh: 演出后，他们根据盒子上的名字把玩具还给对应的人。

parallelText.en: The rabbit goes home clean and dry, and the owner thanks them for taking care of it.
parallelText.zh: 兔子干净、干燥地回到主人手中，主人感谢他们的照顾。
